_comment: Walk-forward validation of MTF Confluence Lean, 15m chart. Anchored (expanding) training windows, contiguous 2-month out-of-sample blocks. Training never sees a bar at or after its fold testStart. CORRECTED 2026-08-24 (OPT-02): this previously claimed 'the search space is left exactly as lean_optimizer15m has it (qty_pct_equity still searched) so this measures the CURRENT procedure end-to-end'. Both halves are false, measured from the two params.json files: this tree searches 30 parameters INCLUDING qty_pct_equity, while lean_optimizer15m searches 18 and pins qty_pct_equity to 0. These folds do NOT measure the current procedure, and the current production space has no walk-forward evidence at all. The folds are kept as historical evidence of the procedure that was replaced; re-pointing the space requires a re-run, which needs the market data and compute this checkout does not have. Cost model is the one change: 2 ticks slippage, applied identically in train and test.
